description:
Xbox is back with Day 2 live from the show floor at the XBOX booth at gamescom 2026 in Cologne, Germany.

author: GameSpot
description:
Day 1 of XBOX's two-day broadcast from gamescom 2026 features Minecraft Dungeons II, Forza Horizon 6, Gears of War: E-Day, Fable and much more. The XBOX gamescom Broadcast will be a packed show featuring interviews, special guests, first-look gameplay reveals, new trailers, and more.

The show kicks off Thursday, August 26, at 7am PDT / 10am EDT / 3pm BST / 4pm CEST, as we go live with a closer look at some of the biggest games coming to XBOX.

author: GameSpot
description:
Game Science unveils a brand-new 15-minute gameplay trailer for Black Myth: Zhong Kui, the second title in the Black Myth series. The trailer offers a first look at the protagonist in combat, along with a glimpse of the story.

As the game is still in early development, all footage was captured in-game from a work-in-progress build running at a 21:9 aspect ratio. The final release may differ.

Follow our curator page on steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/6861411-GameSpot-Official/
title: 15 Minutes of Black Myth: Zhong Kui Official Gameplay Trailer
